Wave 31 lane 3 type-fix evidence: scoped tsc against lib/auth/admin-context.ts, lib/auth/acting-context.ts, lib/organizations/identity.ts and their imports passes with 0 diagnostics. Root cause was the local OrganizationProfileRow interface declaring ops_org_id optional while canonical OrganizerAccountIdentityRow requires it, making admin-context.ts:154 unassignable. Fix is type-level only; runtime logic, error codes, and messages unchanged.

2026-09-26 Wave 35. The phone-privacy gap the admin lane reported is real and the repair is deliberately incomplete. profiles.show_phone is a real boolean column (supabase/migrations/20250819100000_profiles_expand_fields.sql:49-51, default false) and is the SOLE publication gate; profiles.phone exists in no active migration and in no generated contract, so every `show_phone === true ? profile.phone : null` was green and returned null. Established the full gate inventory (lib/profile/general-public-profile.ts:27 public and correct, lib/profile/custom-profile-prompt.ts:88, app/api/profile/custom-design/route.ts:126,129, app/api/connect/sessions/route.ts:146) and the full writer inventory (app/api/settings/profile/route.ts:85 writes the column; app/api/profile/update/route.ts wrote metadata only).

2026-09-26 Wave 35. Chosen treatment, provably no more permissive: the canonical phone storage is profiles.profile_data.phone and the gate expression is unchanged. The self-only preview (app/api/profile/custom-design/route.ts) is repointed to the canonical storage, because the value returned is the authenticated caller's own. The LLM-prompt snapshot (lib/profile/custom-profile-prompt.ts) is pinned to `phone: null` with an explicit comment, because it is serialized into a third-party model prompt and repointing it would move a real phone number across a trust boundary. No route that lacked a top-level show_phone write gained one, and a test asserts that app/api/profile/update/route.ts contains no profileUpdate.show_phone and no profileUpdate.phone.

2026-09-26 Wave 35. Authorization defect found and fixed in the general-user grant: app/api/settings/route.ts accepted a caller-supplied profile_id on both verbs. RLS blocked the cross-user WRITE (profiles_update USING (id = auth.uid())) but the route answered success:true for a zero-row update, and RLS never blocked the cross-user READ because profiles_select is USING (true) in the active chain, so GET returned another user's entire profile row — metadata and profile_data jsonb included — to any authenticated caller. Both verbs now return 403 and issue no query. 5 route tests cover it.

2026-09-26 Wave 35. MFA drift verdict: RETIRE. Independently re-derived the importer set: lib/services/mfa.service.ts is imported by exactly hooks/use-mfa.ts and __tests__/integrations/mfa.service.test.ts, and the hook had zero importers. hooks/use-mfa.ts (468 lines) is DELETED as step 1 of the ordered unlock; the service files are routed by handoff because lib/services/** is design-system's grant. The user_mfa_* relations the service reads are created by no SQL file under supabase/ and are already superseded by 20260918213707_mfa_verification_codes.
